title: Research-only complete candidate carrier for prescribed-groundwater-level inside-profile trials

scope.purpose: Provide a complete research trial object around direct HeadCalc without changing the production Reference solver admission guard.

output: effective H_phreatic_cm after frozen source snap rule
rules: The carrier deep-copies the immutable origin before HeadCalc; the caller-owned origin is intent(in) and must remain bitwise unchanged.
The carrier sets candidate gwlinp from H_phreatic and carries H_phreatic explicitly; it does not overload mode-5 bottom_head semantics.
For inside-profile trials, qbot authority is the value diagnosed by legacy HeadCalc's complete vertical-flux reconstruction.
The branch/active-node classifier is a frozen source-derived control diagnostic, not new physics.
No result is committed and no mass authority is published outside the returned trial object.
gates: For the preregistered LOW01-B levels -60, -120 and -200 cm, branch=INSIDE_PROFILE and active nodes are 1,2,3.
Carrier output effective H_phreatic equals the source-effective gwlinp and fllowgwl=false.
Carrier candidate state and diagnostics are deterministic on A-B-A/repeated immutable-origin calls.
Caller-owned origin is bitwise unchanged after every trial.
The carrier refuses above-top, below-bottom-node and branch-boundary cases in OUTPUT01 rather than silently widening scope.
next_if_pass: Bind LOW01-B live inside-profile qualification to this carrier; then design LOW01-D at the enclosing FMR transaction layer.
